name: Soar, glide, stoop, flare, climb, ride the ridge
description: One lap is 26 s. The hawk circles 2.5 turns up a thermal with no flapping, glides away, stoops onto the mouse (about 244 in/s at the bottom), flares with its feet out, flaps hard (62 beats a lap at 2.4 per second, only while climbing) and rides the bluff's updraft back into the thermal. Speed comes from gravity, drag and flap thrust along the path (g = 150 in/s^2 in this scaled world).
